title: Daredevil #1 Marvel 2014 All-New Marvel Now Mark Waid Chris Samnee Cover Vol 4
conditionDescription: Front cover with light creasing and two small surface marks at lower left; back cover with scuffing and color loss at the upper left edge. See photos.
descriptionText:
Daredevil #1 (May 2014, vol. 4), Marvel Comics - All-New Marvel NOW! first issue, Daredevil 50th anniversary. Written by Mark Waid, art and cover by Chris Samnee, colors by Javier Rodriguez. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Captain America: The Winter Soldier / Harley-Davidson ad.

Condition: light creasing and two small surface marks at the lower left of the front cover; scuffing and color loss along the upper left edge of the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
